strongest_angle: Comparing the investigative and deductive methods of Sherlock Holmes against the animalistic supernatural traits of Count Dracula in late nineteenth-century London settings.

key_facts.fact: At the very beginning of the first Sherlock Holmes story, Watson compares Holmes's deductions to supernatural powers, stating he would have been burned centuries ago.
In Loren D. Estleman's novel Sherlock Holmes vs Dracula, Count Dracula is portrayed with animalistic traits, crawling on castle walls with his cloak spreading like the wings of a monstrous bat.
Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate bizarre nocturnal events terrorising London after the arrival of a mysterious ship in crossover narratives.
